article_manifest.title: Dosso/Presidential initiative for 1,000 boreholes in the municipalities of Koygolo and Kiota: The Minister of Agriculture and Livestock visits the irrigated sites of Dallol Bosso
article_manifest.original_title: Dosso/Initiative présidentielle 1 000 forages dans les communes de Koygolo et Kiota : Le ministre de l’Agriculture et de l’Élevage sur les sites irrigués du Dallol Bosso
article_manifest.summary: On 19 November 2024, the Minister of Agriculture and Livestock, Colonel Bilaly Gambobo, accompanied by the Governor of the Dosso Region, the Director General of ONAHA, the Director General of Rural Engineering, key officials from the Ministry, regional directors, and officials from the Defence and Security Forces, visited several irrigated sites developed under the Presidential Initiative 1,000.

article_manifest.title: Diffa/Security: 17 weapons, 3 Hilux vehicles seized, and 6 traffickers apprehended on the Diffa-N'Guigmi road.
article_manifest.original_title: Diffa /Sécurité : 17 armes, 03 véhicules Hilux saisis et 06 trafiquants appréhendés sur la route Diffa-N’Guigmi.
article_manifest.summary: It was as part of Operation Nalewa Dolè and in fulfilment of its sovereign duties to protect people and their property that the Traffic Brigade achieved this feat. The ceremony to present this haul to the regional authorities took place on 17 November 2026 at the Command Legion of the National Gendarmerie. .

article_manifest.title: Image Published on 23 November 2026 Africa Burkina Faso: RSF denounces a "new wave of repression" against the media The NGO Reporters Without Borders (RSF) denounced on Monday a "new wave of repression" in Burkina Faso, where the junta recently issued arrest warrants…
article_manifest.original_title: Image Publié le 23 novembre 2026 Afrique Burkina: RSF dénonce une "nouvelle escalade répressive" contre les médias L'ONG Reporters sans Frontières (RSF) a dénoncé lundi une "nouvelle escalade répressive" au Burkina Faso, où la junte a récemment émis des mandats d…
article_manifest.summary: The NGO Reporters Without Borders (RSF) denounces a "new wave of repression" in Burkina Faso against the media. On Monday, the NGO Reporters Without Borders (RSF) denounced a "new wave of repression" in Burkina Faso, where the junta recently issued arrest warrants against journalists and banned the publication of an investigative media outlet. .

article_manifest.title: Attack on two boats near...
article_manifest.original_title: Attaque contre deux bateaux près de...
article_manifest.summary: Attack on two boats near Libya claimed by Kyiv: what we know On Monday, Ukraine claimed responsibility for attacks on two Russian vessels carried out the previous day off the coast of Libya, in what appears to be a further escalation of the war between Kyiv and Moscow. Here is what we know about this operation, claimed by President Volodymyr Zelensky shortly after the UN called for an investigation into these strikes.

article_manifest.title: FAMA Operations: Surgical strikes...
article_manifest.summary: FAMA Operations: Surgical strikes in Kidal and Niono Several positions of armed terrorist groups have been targeted in recent days by precision strikes in the vicinity of Kidal and around Niono. . These operations, which are part of Operation Dougoukoloko, are continuing in order to neutralise any remaining threats in these localities.

article_manifest.title: Refoulement from Guinea: Phew! The humanitarian crisis has been contained
article_manifest.original_title: Refoulés de la Guinée : Ouf ! La crise humanitaire jugulée
article_manifest.summary: Triggered without warning on 2 November 2026 by the unilateral ban on artisanal gold mining in Guinea's Siguiri region, the wave of hundreds of thousands of gold panners forcibly expelled to Mali and Burkina Faso has put a severe strain on border stability and the reception capacities of our countries. .

article_manifest.title: MSF condemns deadly attacks against civilians and a health centre in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: MSF condemns deadly attacks against civilians and a health centre in Mali
article_manifest.summary: On Saturday, 21 November, in Mali, attacks targeted the village of Arabebe, near Niafounké, in the north of the country, as well as Niono, in the Ségou region, in the centre of the country. Two people lost their lives, including a health worker. In addition, two health workers, two caregivers, and a child under five were wounded, all inside Niono hospital.

article_manifest.title: Release of around thirty soldiers: The bold move by FAMa
article_manifest.original_title: Libération d’une trentaine de militaires : Le coup d’audace des FAMa
article_manifest.summary: Around thirty soldiers from the Malian Armed Forces were released last week following a spectacular operation led by the Special Forces and their Russian allies. A successful bold move in the north of the country: combat and transport helicopters, Sukhoi aircraft and the latest-generation drones were deployed in this high-intensity mission, which confirms the growing strength of the FAMa and increasingly affirms Mali's sovereignty over its entire territory every day.

article_manifest.title: MSF Mali attacks: MSF strongly condemns deadly attacks against civilians and a health facility
article_manifest.original_title: MSF Mali attacks: MSF strongly condemns deadly attacks against civilians and a health facility
article_manifest.summary: This Saturday, 21 November, in Mali, attacks targeted the village of Arabebe near Niafounké, in the north of the country, as well as Niono, in the Ségou region, in the centre of the country. Two people lost their lives, including a health worker. In addition, two health workers, two carers and a child under five were wounded, all inside Niono hospital.

article_manifest.title: Australia’s Sanctions on West Bank Settlers Increase Pressure
article_manifest.original_title: Australia’s Sanctions on West Bank Settlers Increase Pressure
article_manifest.summary: Australia announced on November 18 further targeted sanctions on three individuals and four entities involved in illegal settlement expansion and human rights abuses against Palestinians in the West Bank. Although these sanctions are a welcome step, they are long overdue and don’t go far enough. The situation in the West Bank is dire.

article_manifest.title: Mali: JNIM Resistance at Niono Costs Government Troops Dearly Despite Air Support
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: JNIM Resistance at Niono Costs Government Troops Dearly Despite Air Support
article_manifest.summary: Mali's armed forces have suffered another blow in the centre of the country. According to an RFI Hausa report, an attack by fighters of Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) in the town of Niono left a number of Malian soldiers dead. The report says the troops met strong resistance from the jihadists despite support from combat aircraft.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin attacks army and African Corps positions in the centre of the country
article_manifest.original_title: مالي.. نصرة الإسلام تهاجم مواقع للجيش وفيلق أفريقيا وسط البلاد
article_manifest.summary: On Saturday, the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) attacked at least two positions of the Malian army and the forces of the Russian Africa Corps in the Ségou region in central Mali, resulting in several casualties among the army, according to Radio France Internationale. The radio station reported that the attackers arrived on motorcycles, in vehicles and on foot, and targeted key military positions in the Niono region, where fierce clashes took place, and burning vehicles were seen inside one of the camps.

article_manifest.title: NIONO: The FAMa intensify strikes against terrorist positions following the attack on the town, with several targets neutralised
article_manifest.original_title: NIONO : Les FAMa intensifient les frappes contre les positions terroristes après l’attaque de la ville, plusieurs cibles neutralisées
article_manifest.summary: Niono: The FAMa strike several terrorist positions as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Operation Dougoukoloko: Three waves of airstrikes against armed terrorist groups. The Malian army continues security operations around Niono.

article_manifest.title: As risks escalate in the Sahel region… the Algerian army seizes attack drones near the border with Mali
article_manifest.original_title: في ظل تفاقم المخاطر بمنطقة الساحل… الجيش الجزائري يحجز مسيّرات هجومية قرب الحدود مع مالي
article_manifest.summary: Algiers - Al-Quds Al-Arabi: The Algerian army announced the discovery of a hideout containing an arsenal of weapons and ammunition in the area of Bordj Badji Mokhtar, in the far south of the country, near the border with Mali. This operation attracted attention due to the nature of the seized equipment, which is not limited to conventional weapons but also includes attack drones, at a time when the Sahel region is witnessing an increase in the use of drones by armed groups and a rise in the activity of arms smuggling networks.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: FAMa: Several strikes against terrorist groups in the Kidal and Niono regions
article_manifest.original_title: FAMa : Plusieurs frappes contre les groupes terroristes dans les régions de Kidal et de Niono
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 22 November (AMAP) The National Defence Forces, with the support of their partners, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, carried out several strikes against terrorist groups between 18 and 21 November 2023, in the Kidal and Niono regions, according to a statement from the Armed Forces General Staff. . The press release states that, on Wednesday, 18 November, thanks to intelligence, the army identified a meeting place for armed terrorist groups 119 km south-west of Kidal, and then struck it after confirming the target.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The FAMa strike several terrorist positions around Niono
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : les FAMa frappent plusieurs positions terroristes autour de Niono
article_manifest.summary: On Saturday, 21 November 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) carried out several waves of airstrikes against positions held by armed terrorist groups in the vicinity of Niono, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced. According to the military statement, these operations specifically targeted fighters involved in the attack on the town of Niono.

article_manifest.title: Niono: The Malian army announces three waves of strikes against armed groups
article_manifest.original_title: Niono : l'armée malienne annonce trois vagues de frappes contre des groupes armés
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army claims to have struck several positions of armed groups around Niono on Saturday, 21 November. According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, these groups had taken part in the attack on the town. The strikes took place in three waves.

article_manifest.title: NEWS Souleymane SIDIBE Article reserved for our subscribers Niono, Sofara, Kidal and Niafunké: The army strikes down terrorist groups
article_manifest.original_title: ACTUALITES Souleymane SIDIBE Article réservé à nos abonnés Niono, Sofara, Kidal et Niafunké : L’armée foudroie des groupes terroristes
article_manifest.summary: The document states that, on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, a camp belonging to armed terrorist groups, housing several individuals as well as logistical equipment including motorcycles, was targeted by precision strikes fifteen kilometres southeast of Niono. On the same day, in the Sofara area, a terrorist pick-up truck concealed under a tree was neutralised, with a secondary explosion...

article_manifest.title: Niger: Two individuals neutralised and a logistics base dismantled in Tillabéri
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : deux individus neutralisés et une base logistique démantelée à Tillabéri
article_manifest.summary: According to a statement from the institution, the operation was carried out jointly by the Torodi National Guard squadron and the Alpha Zero unit, as part of offensive operations to secure the national territory. The provisional toll stands at two individuals neutralised and five AK-47-type assault rifles recovered. Three motorbikes were also seized, while two other motorbikes and a bicycle were destroyed.
